content.content: How much time do I have to go to my lunch with Sarah on 2024-05-15. Give me the result in the format 'HH:MM'.

- "all_day": false
  "description": "Catch up over lunch."
  "end_time": 2024-05-15 13:30:00
  "id_": "9"
  "location": "Central Park Cafe"
  "participants":
  - "emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com"
  - "sarah.connor@gmail.com"
  "start_time": 2024-05-15 12:30:00
  "status": "confirmed"
  "title": "Lunch with Sarah"

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class LunchEventInfo(BaseModel):
    start_time: datetime

events = search_calendar_events("lunch with Sarah", "2024-05-15")
if len(events) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No lunch with Sarah found on 2024-05-15.")

event_info = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract the start time of the lunch with Sarah from this event list. Only consider events that are lunches with Sarah.",
    LunchEventInfo,
)
lunch_start = event_info.start_time

current_day_str = get_current_day()
current_time = datetime.now()
if current_day_str == "2024-05-15":
    now = current_time
else:
    now = datetime.strptime("2024-05-15 00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

if lunch_start < now:
    print("00:00")
else:
    delta = lunch_start - now
    hours, remainder = divmod(int(delta.total_seconds()), 3600)
    minutes = remainder // 60
    print("{:02d}:{:02d}".format(hours, minutes))
```
